pronunciation: in · fin · ih · TESS · ih · mul
definition: Extremely small, almost too small to measure.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: You miss an infinitesimal line and you can build it into a pyramid of evidence!
example_sentence: The chance of the train being on time was infinitesimal.
